scientific limitations/integrity.claim_scope: Exact \(k\)-metric dimensions, complete minimum-basis classifications, and exact basis counts for crown graphs \(\operatorname{Cr}_n\) with \(n\ge3\) and all feasible \(k\).
scientific limitations/integrity.computational_limit: The bundled verifier exhausts all vertex subsets for \(3\le n\le9\); the infinite theorem is proved symbolically and does not rely on that cutoff.
scientific limitations/integrity.literature_risk: Focused published-finding corpus and web searches under crown, matching-deleted biclique, bipartite-double-cover, and bipartite-Kneser aliases found no covering theorem; unindexed literature remains a residual risk.
scientific limitations/integrity.proof_integrity: The proof computes every distinctive-set type directly and reduces the problem to a finite profile inequality \(c_i+c_j\ge k\); no external lemma is needed for the infinite claim.
